name: Event registration system with waitlist and multi-tier PDFs (PDF Generator API)

parameters.content:
## 🎫 Event Registration System with Waitlist & Multi-Tier PDFs
### Powered by PDF Generator API

Automate end-to-end event registration: check capacity, generate tier-specific PDF tickets with QR codes, email attendees, and manage a waitlist with automatic promotion when a spot opens.

## How it works

**Flow A — New Registration**
1. Attendee submits the registration form (name, email, event details, ticket tier)
2. Current registrations are read from Google Sheets to check remaining capacity
3. **Spots available →** routes by tier (General / VIP / Backstage), generates a PDF ticket via PDF Generator API, emails it, logs to Sheets, and sends a Slack alert to the organizer
4. **Event full →** adds the attendee to the Waitlist tab and sends a waitlist confirmation email

**Flow B — Cancellation & Promotion**
1. A POST request hits the Cancellation Webhook with `{ "ticket_id": "TKT-XXXXXXXX" }`
2. Ticket ID is validated and the registration is marked `CANCELED` in Sheets
3. **Waitlist has entries →** the first person is promoted: PDF ticket generated, emailed, logged in Registrations, and a Slack alert sent
4. **Waitlist is empty →** cancellation-only Slack alert is sent to the organizer

---

## Set up steps
1. **PDF Generator API** — Create 3 ticket templates (General, VIP, Backstage) at [pdfgeneratorapi.com](https://pdfgeneratorapi.com). Use variables: `ticket_id`, `attendee_name`, `event_name`, `venue`, `event_date`, `seat_number`, `ticket_tier`, `issued_date`. Add a **QR Code** component bound to `{{ ticket_id }}`
2. **Template IDs + Capacity** — In **"Check Capacity & Prepare Data"** (Flow A) and **"Promote from Waitlist"** (Flow B), replace the 3 placeholder template IDs and set `MAX_CAPACITY`
3. **Google Sheets** — Create a spreadsheet with two tabs: **Registrations** and **Waitlist** (see the Sheets setup note on the right). Update the Spreadsheet ID in all Google Sheets nodes
4. **Gmail** — Connect your Gmail (OAuth2) account in the 3 email nodes: Send Ticket, Send Waitlist Email, Send Promotion Email
5. **Slack** — Connect your Slack account and update the recipient ID in all 3 Slack nodes
6. **Cancellation** — Wire the Cancellation Webhook URL into your site with POST body: `{ "ticket_id": "TKT-XXXXXXXX" }`

### 📊 Google Sheets Setup

Create one spreadsheet with **two tabs**:

**Tab 1: Registrations**
Columns: `Ticket ID` · `Name` · `Email` · `Event` · `Venue` · `Date` · `Seat` · `Tier` · `PDF URL` · `Registered At`

**Tab 2: Waitlist**
Columns: `Position` · `Name` · `Email` · `Event` · `Venue` · `Date` · `Seat` · `Tier` · `Waitlisted At`

Connect your Google Sheets account in all Sheets nodes and set the Spreadsheet ID.

💡 The **Position** column in Waitlist is auto-assigned. The first person added gets position 1, and promotion always picks the lowest position.

### 🔲 QR Code & Multi-Tier Templates

The QR code is a **native component** inside your PDF Generator API templates — not generated externally by this workflow.

**Setup per template (General, VIP, Backstage):**
1. Open the template in the PDF Generator API editor
2. Add a **QR Code** component
3. Set its data source to `{{ ticket_id }}`

**Why 3 templates?**
Each tier can have a unique design, colour scheme, and perks section while sharing the same data variables. The Switch node routes to the correct template ID automatically.

---
**Output format:** `URL` — returns a hosted PDF link (valid 30 days).
Change to `File` in the PDF Generator API nodes to attach the PDF directly to the email instead.

### 🅰️ Flow A — New Registration

Triggered by the **Event Registration Form**.

1. **Check Capacity** — reads current Registrations from Sheets and compares the row count to `MAX_CAPACITY`
2. **Event Full? (IF)** — True → Waitlist branch; False → ticket generation branch
3. **Route by Tier (Switch)** — sends to the General, VIP, or Backstage path to attach the correct tier perks
4. **Generate PDF** — calls PDF Generator API with the tier's template ID; returns a hosted PDF URL (valid 30 days)
5. **Build & Send Email** — constructs an HTML email with event details and a download button; sends via Gmail
6. **Log & Notify** — appends the registration to the Sheets Registrations tab; posts a Slack alert to the organizer
7. **Waitlist path** — if full: appends to Waitlist tab and sends a waitlist confirmation email

### 🅱️ Flow B — Cancellation & Waitlist Promotion

Triggered by a **POST webhook**. Send:
`POST <webhook-url>` with `{ "ticket_id": "TKT-XXXXXXXX" }`

1. **Validate** — checks that `ticket_id` exists and matches the `TKT-XXXXXXXX` format; throws an error if invalid
2. **Remove Registration** — updates the matching row in Sheets to `Status: CANCELED`
3. **Check Waitlist (IF)** — if Waitlist tab is empty → sends a cancellation-only Slack alert and ends
4. **Promote** — picks the first waitlisted attendee (lowest row), generates their ticket PDF, emails the promotion, logs to Registrations, marks as `PROMOTED` in Waitlist, and sends a Slack alert

### 🔔 Slack Notifications

The workflow sends three types of Slack alerts:

1. **New Registration** — when a ticket is issued
2. **Waitlist Promotion** — when a waitlisted attendee gets promoted
3. **Cancellation Only** — when someone cancels and the waitlist is empty

**Setup:** Connect Slack in each notification node and choose your channel (e.g. `#event-tickets`). Remove all Slack nodes if you don't use Slack.

### ⚙️ Required: Edit Before Running

Two **Code nodes** contain placeholder template IDs that must be replaced before the workflow will work:

**"Check Capacity & Prepare Data"** (Flow A)
**"Promote from Waitlist"** (Flow B)

In each node, update the `TEMPLATES` object:
- `'General Admission': YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID`
- `'VIP': YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID`
- `'Backstage Pass': YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID`

Also set `MAX_CAPACITY` to your event size
(currently `3` — demo only).

## Ticket Tier Routing
Event full → Waitlist. Has spots → route by tier (General / VIP / Backstage) and attach tier perks.

## Waitlist Promotion
Promotes the first queued attendee: PDF ticket generated, emailed, logged, and removed from waitlist. Waitlist empty → cancellation-only Slack alert.
